headlines.title: Severe storms upend Thanksgiving travel and leave hundreds of thousands without power
headlines.description: High winds and heavy rains hammered both coasts and hundreds of thousands remained without power after foul weather made for a miserable Thanksgiving for many.

headlines.title: Severe Thanksgiving storms threaten millions of travelers nationwide and Macy’s parade
headlines.description: Heavy rain and strong winds in the Northeast on Thanksgiving Day will not only make travel difficult and dampen the holiday season kickoff, but also put the famed Macy’s parade in jeopardy.

headlines.title: Storms expected on both coasts, threatening Thanksgiving travel
headlines.description: Strong storms, serious flooding and powerful winds could dampen Thanksgiving travel plans and celebrations in parts of the Northeast and California, forecasters said.

headlines.title: Delta restores system after nationwide flight delays as Thanksgiving travel begins
headlines.description: Delta Air Lines said it restored an automated system Sunday afternoon after a problem with it delayed flights nationwide as Thanksgiving travel got underway.

headlines.title: Sean Duffy’s $50B demand for air travel fixes is met with yelling and skepticism in Congress
headlines.description: The Trump administration’s request for $50.1 billion in new FAA funding after a nationwide ground stop is running into skepticism from both parties in Congress.

headlines.title: United Airlines says it has resolved a ‘widespread system outage’
headlines.description: United Airlines on Monday said a widespread system outage that delayed flight departures is over.

headlines.title: The ground stop stranded a woman and her team. Her husband suggested she buy a ‘fun’ car.
headlines.description: A nationwide ground stop left Tara Harding and her employees stranded. Striking out on planes and trains, she opted to just buy an automobile.

headlines.title: Flight delays and cancellations return to normal levels after weekend of travel chaos
headlines.description: Air travel across the United States was largely returning to normal Monday, although some disruption persisted as airlines scrambled to get back on schedule after a rare nationwide ground stop.

headlines.title: 2 injured after taxiing planes collide at Miami International Airport
headlines.description: Two taxiing planes collided at Miami International Airport on Saturday night, officials said, a day after a nationwide ground stop disrupted flights across the country.

headlines.title: Jordon Hudson sues Airbnb hosts, blaming them for shirtless Bill Belichick video
headlines.description: Images of the bare-chested Belichick were “egregious violations of her privacy,” as Hudson’s relationship with the former Patriots coach was a “fiercely guarded” secret, her suit says.

headlines.title: Wave of bomb threats against European airliners triggers diversions and tarmac searches
headlines.description: No explosives have been found, and it isn’t clear who or what is behind the calls, but the threats alone have caused chaos in the skies and airports.

headlines.title: Airbnb hosts can no longer ask guests to clean dishes or make beds
headlines.description: Customers don’t have “to complete tasks that require significant effort or time, or would typically be performed by a cleaner,” according to the home-sharing app.
